description: This file defines the EndpointArnMiddleware class responsible for handling ARN parsing and endpoint modification for AWS S3 control operations, particularly focusing on access point and bucket ARNs, including Outposts ARNs.

classes.name: EndpointArnMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for handling ARN-based endpoint modifications in AWS S3 control operations.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Creates a middleware wrapper function for a given service, region, config, and endpoint version flag.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the middleware with handler, service, region, config, and endpoint version flag.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main middleware execution method that processes commands and modifies requests based on ARNs.

methods.name: generateOutpostsArnHost
methods.description: Generates the host for Outposts ARNs based on ARN data and configuration.

methods.name: generateOutpostIdHost
methods.description: Generates the host for Outpost ID redirection.

methods.name: validateBucketArn
methods.description: Validates that an ARN is a valid S3 bucket ARN.

methods.name: validateAccessPointArn
methods.description: Validates that an ARN is a valid S3 access point ARN.

methods.name: validateArn
methods.description: Validates an ARN, ensuring partition and region consistency, and returns the partition object.
